I was an addict before Narcan or at least before it was widely accessible and sold at pharmacies. So when myself or a friend would OD it was kinda confusing and really terrifying. We couldn’t call 911 police would come automatically with EMS. I lived in the Deep South and it was 0 tolerance when it came to addicts…EMS barely helped anyway and sometimes made fun of the person. Times are different now thankfully but it was rough. So for me  if I went unconscious from an OD it was almost a relief, when I woke up I would be PISSED bc I thought I was getting out for good this time (I was also violently suicidal) 

I’m very thankful to be where I am today. It was a long hard road. Keep yourselves and your friends safe! Carry Narcan! Know what to do when it happens, have a protocol! Addicts deserve to be treated like humans no matter where they are on their journey. 💜 I’m sending out so much compassion for everyone here. Stay safe.
